[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/std/temp_file.lani#L4)

Layer: `std`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Named temporary-file ownership implemented in Lanius over bounded OS entropy and existing Linux calls. Keep one manual TempFile owner; creation retains a CLOEXEC directory duplicate, validates directory metadata/flags and exclusively creates a 0600 no-follow file from a fresh 16-byte OS-entropy candidate. Destination exclusion occurs before open. Same-owner keep disarms deletion without I/O; file close retires once; failed removal retains name/anchor authority for explicit retry or keep. Parent namespaces must be exclusive/cooperative, not hostile. Combined TempFile/FileOps acceptance covers 78 process invocations across owner 8/collisions 6/validation 18/faults 19/primitives 27 on native Linux x86_64/kernel 7.0.0-38-generic/ext4 under /tmp, including repeated baselines rather than distinct behaviors. Faults reach one 37-byte dynamic source OOM; 26 CPU controls and three verified runtime pairs per ELF support source/fd ledgers and applicable pre-exit ownership checks. Cargo --no-run driver admission is separate from native execution. AtomicFile, kv_tool migration, crash durability and scavenging remain outside this checkpoint. No cryptographic algorithm or new runtime binding is added.
